theorems.name: Submission.cbrldlf_exists_small_scale_of_lower_density
theorems.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < (unitBallVolume n).toReal ∧ ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (x₁ : Euclid P) (η₀ δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → liminf (fun r : ℝ => μ (ball x₁ r) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) < ENNReal.ofReal η₀ → ∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ s < δ ∧ μ (ball x₁ s) < ENNReal.ofReal (η₀ * (unitBallVolume n).toReal * s ^ n)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
